lines.text: Every night at 2 AM, my dad sneaks downstairs... and the reason made me cry.

lines.text: He works double shifts. He's never played a game with me.

lines.text: He always said... 'I'm too old for that, buddy.'

lines.text: Then I kept hearing clicking downstairs. 2 AM. Every night.

image.prompt: {leo} sitting up awake in a dark room at night, moonlight through the window, hugging a pillow, listening with wide worried eyes

lines.label: LAST WEEK

lines.text: I checked the console. A new profile.

lines.text: Forty-seven hours... all on level one.

lines.text: Friday, I snuck down and caught him.

lines.label: FRIDAY, 2 AM

lines.text: Still in his work uniform. Losing. Again.

image.prompt: {dad} sitting on the floor of a cozy dark living room at night lit only by a glowing TV, squinting hard at the screen, gripping a game controller, tired but determined

lines.text: 'Your birthday's Saturday. I didn't want to be bad... when I finally play with you.'

lines.text: I didn't say a word. I sat down... and picked up player two.

lines.text: We lost eleven times. Best night of my life.

lines.text: Mom can't figure out why we're both so tired. Because...
